name: Joliapp Creator Video Embed
author: joliapp

sections.description:
Add a scrolling row of the creator videos Joli has made for your venue. Each card links to the creator’s original post and carries descriptive alt text, and because the block is written into the page on the server, search engines that do not run JavaScript can read it too.

This plugin needs a Joli brand account: the videos come from Joli’s service, and nothing shows without one. Joli is a platform that connects hospitality brands with local creators.

Add the “Joliapp creator videos” block where you want the videos and paste your Joli ID into its settings. To get the ID, open Settings, Integrations in Joli, choose Set Up on the WordPress row, pick a location and copy the ID. It starts with loc_ for one venue or brnd_ for all of them.

On a page builder such as Elementor or Divi, or the classic editor, use the shortcode instead:

[joli_embed venue="loc_..." heading="As seen on social media"]

Use brand="brnd_..." instead of venue to show every venue. Options: heading, subheading, level (h2 or h3).

External service

This plugin fetches the block from widget.joliapp.com (Joli) when a page that uses it is built, and caches it for 25 minutes. Only the venue or brand ID, your display options and your site’s domain are sent. Visitors’ browsers load a small script and stylesheet from the same address to play videos. Terms of service: https://joliapp.com/legal/terms-of-service/ and privacy policy: https://joliapp.com/legal/privacy-policy/

Caching

If your host or a caching plugin keeps full copies of your pages, changes to your videos reach the page only when that cache is purged. Purge it after new videos go live if you need them sooner.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New Plugin and search for Joliapp.
  2. Install and activate Joliapp Creator Video Embed.
  3. In Joli, open Settings, Integrations and choose Set Up on the WordPress row. Pick a location and copy the ID.
  4. Add the Joliapp creator videos block where you want the videos, paste the ID into its settings and publish the page.
